presets.title: Crowded neighborhood
presets.description: Dense local space. Small stars stay on the map; jumps are short. Humans share the neighborhood with methane-breathers, living crystal, and hot-world gas-giant people.

presets.title: Sparse neighborhood
presets.description: Fewer stars: the smallest red dwarfs are dropped. Jumps run longer so the remaining systems still form one network. Several habitat classes remain.

presets.title: Lonely humans
presets.description: Sun-like stars only (about 0.66–1.5 solar masses). Longer jumps keep one thin network. Only oxygen-breathing humans; no alien cultures.
